Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:10:1.english: Is considered like the offspring in an animal’s womb - In that he does not trace his lineage after his father at all.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:12:1.hebrew: עשרה יוחסין עלו מבבל - כשעלו בני הגולה. ובגמרא מפרש לה, דאשמועינן שמשפחות שבבבל מיוחסות הן, שהפריש עזרא כל הפסולין משם והוליכן עמו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:12:1.english: Ten [categories of] lineage ascended from Babylonia - When the people of the exile ascended. And in the Gemara it explains it: that it teaches us that the families in Babylonia are of [pure] lineage, for Ezra separated all those of disqualified lineage from there and brought them with him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:12:2.english: Ḥalalim - Disqualified priests who were born from [unions] disqualified for the priesthood.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:12:4.hebrew: נתיני - גבעונים שמלו בימי יהושע, ואמרינן ביבמות (דף עח:): דוד גזר עליהם:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:12:4.english: Netinei - Gibeonites who were circumcised in the days of Joshua; and we say in Yevamot (78b): David decreed against them.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:12:5.hebrew: שתוקי ואסופי - מפרש להו ואזיל: איזוהי שתוקי כו':
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:12:5.english: A shetuki and an asufi - [The Mishnah] proceeds to explain them: "Who is a shetuki?..." etc.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:13:1.hebrew: לויי וישראלי חללי גירי וחרורי מותרים לבא זה בזה - אבל כהנים בחללי, גירי וחרורי — לא, שחללה בלאו, וגיורת ומשוחררת בחזקת זונה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:13:1.english: Levites, Israelites, ḥalalim, converts, and freed slaves are permitted to marry one another - But priests [may] not [marry] ḥalalim, converts, and freed slaves, for a ḥalalah is [forbidden to a priest] by a negative commandment, and a female convert and an emancipated maidservant are presumed [to have the status of] a zonah.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:14:1.hebrew: גירי וחרורי ממזרים כו' מותרים לבא זה בזה - דקסבר: קהל גרים לא איקרי קהל, ולא הוזהרו ממזרים לבא בקהל גרים. אבל לויים ישראלים בממזרי — לא. ושתוקי ואסופי — ספק ממזרים הם, ומותרים להתערב בממזרים, כדאמר בגמרא (לקמן קידושין דף עג.): בקהל ודאי הוא דלא יבא, בקהל ספק יבא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:14:1.english: Converts, and emancipated slaves, mamzerim, etc., are permitted to enter into [marriage with] one another - For he holds that the congregation of converts is not called a “congregation,” and mamzerim were not prohibited from entering into the congregation of converts. However, Levites [and] Israelites [may] not [marry] with mamzerim. And a shetuki and an asufi are [people of] uncertain mamzer status, and they are permitted to intermarry with mamzerim, as it says in the Gemara (below, Kiddushin 73a): It is into a certain congregation that he may not enter, but into an uncertain congregation he may enter.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:14:2.hebrew: ואינו מכיר את אביו - וכשקורא פלוני אבא, אמו משתקתו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:14:2.english: And does not know his father - And when he calls [out], "So-and-so is [my] father," his mother silences him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:14:3.english: Beduki - In the Gemara, it explains it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:15:1.hebrew: מילתא אגב אורחיה קא משמע לן - על פי דרכו שהיה הולך ומדבר דבריו ליוחסין, השמיענו ולמדנו דבר חדש בלישנא דנקט, ולמדנו עוד ממנו דא"י גבוה מבבל:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:15:1.english: He teaches us a matter in passing - In the course of his way, as he was going along and speaking his words concerning lineages, he informed us and taught us a novel matter through the wording that he used, and taught us further from it that Eretz Yisrael is higher than Babylonia.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:16:1.hebrew: בשלמא בית המקדש גבוה - דשמעת מינה, דהא בארץ ישראל משתעי קרא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:16:1.english: Granted, the Temple is higher - For you deduce from it that the verse is speaking about Eretz Yisrael.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:1:1.english: One who says to his maidservant - [Who is] pregnant.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:1:2.hebrew: הרי את בת חורין - בגט שחרור זה, וולדך עבד:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:1:2.english: You are hereby a free woman - [He says to her: "You are hereby a free woman] with this bill of emancipation, and your offspring [shall remain] a slave."

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:1:3.hebrew: ולדה כמוה - משוחרר, כדיליף בסיפא, שנאמר: "האשה וילדיה תהיה לאדוניה" — בזמן שהאשה לאדוניה, הולד שתלד לאדוניה; אין האשה לאדוניה, אין הולד לאדוניה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:1:3.english: Her offspring is like her - [He is] emancipated, as is derived in the latter clause [of the baraita], as it is stated: “The wife and her children shall be her master’s” (Exodus 21:4) — as long as the woman belongs to her master, the offspring she bears belongs to her master; [when] the woman does not belong to her master, the offspring does not belong to her master.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:2:1.english: What is the derivation - Where do we learn from this verse [that] his statement is upheld?

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:2:2.hebrew: אמר רבא אדרבי יוסי הגלילי - האי קרא אדרבי יוסי קאי: ולדה כמוה, משום שנא' כו':
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:2:2.english: Rava said: [It refers] to Rabbi Yosei HaGelili - This verse refers to [the statement of] Rabbi Yosei: Her offspring is like her, because it is stated, etc.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:1.hebrew: יכולין ממזרין ליטהר - מפסול זרעם, שלא יהו בניהם ממזרים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:1.english: Mamzerim can be purified - From the disqualification of their offspring, so that their children will not be mamzerim.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:2.hebrew: עשרה יוחסין עלו מבבל - כשעלו בני הגולה. ובגמרא מפרש לה, דאשמועינן שמשפחות שבבבל מיוחסות הן, שהפריש עזרא כל הפסולין משם והוליכן עמו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:2.english: Ten lineages ascended from Babylonia - [This occurred] when the members of the exile ascended. And in the Gemara it explains this: that it teaches us that the families in Babylonia are of unblemished lineage, for Ezra separated all those of disqualified lineage from there and brought them with him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:3.hebrew: יכולין ממזרין ליטהר - מפסול זרעם, כלומר שלא יהו בניהם ממזרים:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:3.english: Mamzerim can be purified - From the disqualification of their offspring, [meaning] that their children will not be mamzerim.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:4.hebrew: בנה עבד - ואין ממזר, דהא ולדה כמוה:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:4.english: Her son is a slave - and not a mamzer, for her offspring is like her.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:5.english: A freeman - And he is permitted to [marry] a Jewish woman.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:6.hebrew: הרי זה עבד ממזר - בגמרא יליף לה טעמא:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:3:6.english: Behold, this is a mamzer slave - In the Gemara, [the Sages] derive the reason for it.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:1.hebrew: לכתחילה קאמר - ממזר נושא שפחה, דקסבר דכי כתיב "לא יהיה קדש" — בישראל כשר כתיב, ולא בממזר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:1.english: Did he state [it] ab initio - [Meaning that] a mamzer may marry a maidservant [ab initio], for he holds that when it is written: "There shall not be a kadesh," it is written concerning a fit Israelite, and not concerning a mamzer.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:2.hebrew: לכתחילה קאמר - ממזר נושא שפחה, דקסבר דכי כתיב "לא יהיה קדש בישראל" — כשר כתיב, ולא בממזר:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:2.english: He stated it ab initio - A mamzer may marry a maidservant, for he holds that when it is written, "There shall not be a [male] prostitute (kadesh) in Israel" (Deuteronomy 23:18), it is written about a fit Jew, and not about a mamzer.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:3.hebrew: או דיעבד קאמר - ממזר שנשא שפחה, אבל לכתחילה לא ישא. דהא ישראל הוא, וקרינא ביה "לא יהיה קדש" (דברים כ״ג:י״ח), דמתרגמינן "לא יסב גברא" וגו'. דשפחה הרי היא כבהמה, וביאותיה הפקר וקדישות:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:3.english: Or did he state it after the fact - [Meaning, that] a mamzer who married a maidservant [the marriage stands], but ab initio he may not marry [her]. For he is a Jew, and we read about him "There shall not be a kadesh" (Deuteronomy 23:18), which we translate [in Aramaic] as "A man shall not take [a maidservant]" etc. For a maidservant is like an animal, and relations with her are ownerless [i.e., promiscuous] and [a matter of] licentiousness.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:4.hebrew: טיהרת את הזכרים - שילכו למקום שאין מכירין, ויאמר: עבד אני, ונושא שפחה, ואין מוחה בידו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:4.english: You have purified the males - For they can go to a place where they are not known and say, "I am a slave," and marry a maidservant, and no one protests against him.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:5.hebrew: ואת הנקבות לא טיהרת - אין דרך אשה לגלות ממקומה ולבקש תחבולות לינשא בסתר, מאחר שיש מוחין בידה. אלמא ר' טרפון דיעבד קאמר, דאי לכתחילה, כיון דאין מוחין בידה, ממזרת נמי תנסיב לעבד:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:4:5.english: And the females you have not purified - It is not the way of a woman to leave her place and seek stratagems to marry in secret, since there are those who protest against her [doing so]. Evidently, Rabbi Tarfon spoke after the fact; for if [he had spoken] ab initio, since no one would protest against her [marrying a slave, were that permitted ab initio], a female mamzer too could marry a slave.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:5:1.hebrew: עבד כנעני אין לו חייס - אינו מתיחס אחר אביו, דכתיב (בראשית כ״ב:ה׳) "עם החמור" — עם הדומה לחמור, כבהמה שאין הולד כרוך אחרי האב. הילכך, אי מינסבא לעבדא — לא מהני מידי:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:5:1.english: A Canaanite slave has no lineage - He does not trace lineage after his father, as it is written: “[Stay here] with the donkey” (Genesis 22:5) — a people similar to a donkey, like an animal, where the offspring is not linked to the father. Therefore, if she were to marry a slave, it would not accomplish anything.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:6:1.hebrew: אי אקדמתיך אטהרתיך לבנך - אם הייתי מכירך קודם שנשאת אשה, הייתי משיאך עצה לטהר בניך:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:6:1.english: Had I preceded you, I would have purified your sons - If I had known you before you married a woman, I would have given you advice to purify your sons:

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:6:2.english: It is well - For he would have told him to take a maidservant.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:6:3.hebrew: מאי ניהו - מאי הוה אמר ליה? איסורא לא היה מינסיב עצה למיעבד. ומשני: דמינסיב לו עצה ואמר ליה: "זיל גנוב ותיזדבן לעבד עברי ותהא שפחה מותרת לך" — דמכרוהו בית דין רבו מוסר לו שפחה כנענית, ולא מוכר עצמו, ולהכי נקט "זיל גנוב". והוא הדין נמי מצי לאקשויי: "מי שרי לאנסובי עצה למיגנב?", אלא מקשיא אחרת סלקיה; דאי הוה מקשי ליה הא, הוה מצי ליה לשנויי: אלא דאמר ליה "מכור עצמך לעבד עברי", וכרבי אליעזר, דאמר בפרק קמא (לעיל קידושין דף יד:): "זה וזה רבו מוסר לו שפחה כנענית":
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:6:3.english: What was it - What could he have said to him? He would not have given advice to commit a transgression! And [the Gemara] answers that he would give him advice and say to him: "Go steal and be sold as a Hebrew slave, and a maidservant will be permitted to you" — for [in the case of] one sold by the court, his master may assign him a Canaanite maidservant, but not [in the case of] one who sells himself; and that is why [the Gemara] formulated [it as]: "Go steal." And similarly, [the Gemara] could also have objected: "Is it permitted to give advice to steal?" Rather, it dismissed [the answer] with another objection; for had it raised this objection to it, it would have been able to answer: "Rather, [the advice was] that he said to him: 'Sell yourself as a Hebrew slave,' and in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer, who said in the first chapter (above, Kiddushin 14b): 'Both this one and that one, his master may assign him a Canaanite maidservant.'"

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:7:1.english: But didn’t the Master say - In tractate Arakhin.

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:7:2.hebrew: אלא בזמן שהיובל נוהג - דמצי למקרי ביה: "עד שנת היובל יעבוד עמך":
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:7:2.english: Only when the Jubilee is practiced - So that one can read concerning him: “He shall serve with you until the Jubilee year.”

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:8:1.hebrew: לא יבא לו - דור אחריו הוא מושך, דהכי משמע: דור עשירי לא יבא, אפילו אין בו צד ממזרות אלא מאותו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:8:1.english: Shall not enter to him - It draws the generation after him [to follow his status]; for this is what it implies: A tenth generation shall not enter, even if there is no aspect of mamzerut in him other than from that [parent].

Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:9:1.hebrew: לא יבא לו - דור אחריו הוא מושך, דהכי משמע: דור עשירי לא יבא, אפילו אין בו צד ממזרות אלא מאותו:
Rashi on Kiddushin 69a:9:1.english: Shall not enter of his - He draws the generation after him, for this is what it means: “A tenth generation shall not enter,” even if it has an aspect of mamzerut only from that one [parent].

Tosafot on Kiddushin 69a:6:1.hebrew: אלא אי אמרת דיעבד מאי נינהו - פי' הקונטרס: מאי האי דקאמר ליה? איסורא לא הוה מנסיב ליה עצה למיעבד! וה"ה נמי כשא"ל "זיל גנוב ואיזדבן בעבד עברי", דהוה מצי לאקשויי: ומי שרי להשיאו עצה לגנוב ולעשות איסורא? אלא גמרא פריך שפיר. עוי"ל: דאי הוה מקשה ליה הכי, הוה ליה לשנויי דאמר ליה "זיל ומכור עצמך", וכר' אליעזר, דאמר (לעיל קידושין דף יד:): אחד זה ואחד זה רבו מוסר לו שפחה כנענית:
Tosafot on Kiddushin 69a:6:1.english: "Rather, if you say [it applies only] after the fact, what is it?" - Rashi explained: What is this [advice] that he could have given him? [Surely] he would not have advised him to perform a prohibited act! And the same applies also when [the Gemara suggests that] he told him, "Go steal and be sold as a Hebrew servant," as [the Gemara] could have objected: Is it permitted to advise him to steal and commit a transgression? Rather, the Gemara's question is well formulated. Furthermore, it can be said that had it raised this objection against him, it could have answered that he said to him, "Go and indenture yourself [as a Hebrew servant]," and in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer, who said (above, Kiddushin 14b): Both this one and that one, his master may provide him with a Canaanite maidservant.
